note: Tech Bila Hype EP.1 redo. v1 was rejected (hands clipped at frame edge, no voice, copy). Same reference-motion approach as v1 (pin 924363892282992611), same violet/cream/ink system, but: full-figure poses with hands visible and fully inside the safe box, Kiswahili VO (voice-18, scratch Kiswahili TTS for review — owner records his own read for the final), lip-synced mouth, tighter copy. copy.json is the record of the exact words spoken.

en: Welcome to Tech Bila Hype. Episode one: the text is unreadable.
takes.say: Karibu Tech Bila Hype. Kipindi cha kwanza: maandishi hayasomeki.

en: Every day you see long captions.
takes.say: Kila siku unaona captions ndefu. Ukweli ni rahisi: mistari midogo, hakuna anayesoma.
Kanuni ya kwanza: neno moja. Kubwa.

sw: rangi mbili tu. Nyingine zote ni kelele.
en: Rule two: only two colors. Everything else is noise.
takes.say: Kanuni ya pili: rangi mbili tu. Nyingine zote ni kelele.

en: Rule three: start with a question. A question stops them.
takes.say: Kanuni ya tatu: anza na swali. Swali huwasimamisha.

en: That's it. Short tips, no hype. Altraware.
takes.say: Hiyo ndiyo. Tips fupi, bila hype. Altraware.
